issuer: Regitra, the state enterprise that registers vehicles and issues driving licences
note: Regitra's own pages (read 2026-10-30). Its category codes page gives the minimum age for category B as 18. A new driver first holds a beginner's licence (pradedančiojo vairuotojo pažymėjimas), issued since April 2019 for 3 years, with the beginner's rules (the maple-leaf sign) for the first 2 years; the licence valid for 10 years can be ordered only once the beginner's 2-year term has ended: the 10-year licence is held, so it is kept from 20 (18 plus the 2 beginner's years; the third year is for ordering the new document). The price list gives issuing a licence within 15 working days at €17.15 (€34.30 in 5, €51.45 in 1), the fee held; the beginner's exchange page gives the same three prices. Delivery (€6.99), the exams and the medical certificate aren't held. No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read.
